coverage.name: Own Damage — Truck & Chassis
coverage.description: Covers accidental damage, fire, explosion, and natural peril loss to the insured truck, chassis, and permanently fitted equipment.

constraints.value: Rigid, Tractor Unit, Tipper, Tanker, Box, Flatbed

coverage.wordingDoc: Commercial Truck Policy Wording — Own Damage clause

coverage.name: Third Party Liability
coverage.description: Statutory and excess third-party liability for death, bodily injury, and property damage arising from commercial truck use.

coverage.name: Driver & Cleaner Personal Accident
coverage.description: Fixed benefit for accidental death or permanent disability of the named driver and cleaner while on duty.

coverage.name: Goods in Transit
coverage.description: Covers loss or damage to lawful cargo carried on the insured truck, including loading and unloading at declared locations.

coverage.name: Trailer & Semi-Trailer
coverage.description: Extends own-damage and theft cover to declared trailers and semi-trailers attached to the insured tractor unit.

coverage.name: Theft & Hijack
coverage.description: Covers theft of the truck, trailer, or cargo following forcible entry, hijack, or armed robbery while in transit.

coverage.name: Breakdown & Recovery
coverage.description: 24/7 commercial recovery, towing to nearest authorised workshop, and roadside mechanical assistance. Up to 6 call-outs per year.

coverage.name: Loading, Unloading & Overturning
coverage.description: Covers damage to the truck, trailer, or cargo caused by loading, unloading, tipping, or overturning during commercial operations.

coverage.name: Windscreen & Glass
coverage.description: Covers accidental damage to windscreen and vehicle glass with nil or reduced excess.

constraints.value: Rigid, Tractor Unit, Tipper, Tanker, Box, Flatbed

coverage.wordingDoc: Commercial Truck Policy Wording — Own Damage clause

questions.label: Make & Model
questions.helpText: Manufacturer and model of the truck, e.g. Tata Prima 4928.S

questions.label: Year of Manufacture

derived.usedIn: Rating factors (vehicle age band), Eligibility rules (max 20 years)

questions.helpText: The year the vehicle was manufactured, as shown on the registration document. Used against the 20-year commercial cap.

validations.msg: Vehicle must be manufactured in 2005 or later.
Year of manufacture cannot be in the future.

questions.label: Gross Vehicle Weight (tonnes)
questions.helpText: Must be 49 tonnes or less for this product.

questions.label: Body Type
questions.helpText: Tankers and tippers may refer to operations underwriting.

questions.label: Insured Value
questions.helpText: Agreed value of the truck and chassis.

questions.label: Tracking Device Fitted?
questions.helpText: Required for full Theft & Hijack and GIT limits.

evidence.message: Upload tracker fitment certificate to restore full GIT and theft limits.

validations.msg: Confirm whether a tracker is fitted.

questions.label: Primary Driver — Date of Birth
questions.helpText: Enter the primary driver's date of birth as shown on their identity document. Driver must be 25 or older at cover start.

derived.usedIn: Rating factors (driver age band), Eligibility rules (minimum age 25)

evidence.message: Upload a scan of the heavy-vehicle licence with date of birth.

questions.label: Goods Class Carried
questions.helpText: Class 1 explosives and radioactive cargo are declined on this product.

questions.label: Night Operations?
questions.helpText: Night haul and tankers may be referred.

eligibility.name: Min Driver Age — Commercial
eligibility.description: Named driver must be at least 25 years old for commercial truck cover.
eligibility.customerMsg: Commercial truck cover is only available to drivers aged 25 and over.

eligibility.name: Valid HGV / CMV Licence
eligibility.description: Primary driver must hold a valid heavy goods or commercial motor vehicle licence.
eligibility.customerMsg: A valid heavy vehicle licence is required for this product.
eligibility.internalMsg: Licence class not in HGV/CMV allowlist.

eligibility.name: Max Vehicle Age
eligibility.description: Truck must be 20 years old or newer.
eligibility.customerMsg: This product is only available for trucks manufactured within the last 20 years.

eligibility.name: GVW Cap
eligibility.description: Gross vehicle weight must not exceed 49 tonnes.
eligibility.customerMsg: Vehicles above 49 tonnes require a specialist fleet product.

eligibility.name: Min HGV Experience
eligibility.description: Primary driver must have at least 2 years of heavy-vehicle experience.
eligibility.customerMsg: Drivers with under 2 years of HGV experience may receive a premium loading.

eligibility.name: Hazardous Goods Refer
eligibility.description: Class 1 explosives and radioactive cargo are referred to specialist underwriting.
eligibility.customerMsg: Hazardous cargo of this class needs a specialist review before we can quote.

eligibility.name: Tracking Device for Theft Cover
eligibility.description: Theft & Hijack requires an active GPS tracking device.
eligibility.customerMsg: Theft cover can be added once an approved tracking device is fitted.

items.name: Base Rate — Commercial Truck
items.notes: Commercial motor base rate validated 12-Aug-2026 against 2025 heavy-vehicle loss ratios.

items.name: Goods Class Factor
items.bands: General merchandise ×1.00 · Perishable / refrigerated ×1.15 · Construction materials ×1.10 · Fuel / flammable liquids ×1.45 · Chemicals (non-explosive) ×1.35

items.name: Payable premium formula
items.expression: Base Premium × Risk Factors + Loadings − Discounts + Add-ons + Fees + Taxes = Payable Premium

underwriting.name: Require inspection for high SI
underwriting.description: Request physical inspection and tracker certificate before bind.

underwriting.name: Standard commercial accept
underwriting.description: Accept if no decline, refer, load, or restrict rule has fired.

distribution.name: Commercial Broker Portal
distribution.description: Appointed commercial motor brokers. Bind up to $200k OD SI.
distribution.desc: Appointed commercial motor brokers. Bind up to $200k OD SI.
